jobs.title: Junior Node.js Developer
jobs.description:
Brightwater Health makes appointment and prescription-reminder software used by 300 community pharmacies in the UK and Ireland. Our engineering team of nine builds everything from the pharmacist dashboard to the SMS reminder pipeline.

We are hiring a Junior Node.js Developer to work on the services that send reminders, handle patient replies and sync with pharmacy systems.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain Node.js (TypeScript) services and REST APIs.
  • Work with PostgreSQL and Redis-backed job queues.
  • Integrate with SMS and email providers and handle delivery webhooks.
  • Write tests and help us keep patient data safe.
  • 1+ year of commercial experience with Node.js.
  • Good knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and of SQL.
  • An understanding of REST API design and basic web security (authentication, input validation).
  • Excellent written English.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (GDPR, NHS DSPT).
  • Docker and AWS.
  • GBP 26,000-32,000 per year (contractor rate available outside the UK).
  • Fully remote with UK-hours overlap (10:00-15:00 GMT).
  • 28 days of holiday and a GBP 500 learning budget.
